name: QualityEssentials
description: Quality of life in one mod: food and saturation, what-am-I-looking-at panel, effect timers, armor and tool HUD, riding HUD, performance overlay, shulker box previews, new item stars, screenshot buttons, a chat section (long history restored after rejoining, bigger window, timestamps, wrong keyboard layout fix), dark loading screen and a keyboard map of key bindings. Every module can be turned off and steps aside when the original mod is installed.
